title: Bilateral Direct Settlement Receipt Specification (Subjective Quality Non-Verifiability Principle)
description: Cryptographically authenticated settlement receipt executed bilaterally between task requester and executor. Formalizes the principle of subjective quality non-verifiability (AER Section 5): state-transition validity is determined strictly by the digital signature of the designated beneficiary, authorizing immediate escrow clearing without subjective intermediary arbitration.

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning string of this formal schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

task_id.description: Unique 32-byte cryptographic identifier of the on-chain escrow or bilateral contract.

worker_node_id.description: EVM address of the executor node designated to receive settlement consideration.

beneficiary_node_id.description: EVM address of the service beneficiary possessing unilateral signature authority for completion confirmation.

solution_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest H(Output) over the execution artifact, log, or computational result.

execution_success.description: Strict boolean assertion of completion satisfaction according to client objective criteria.

gas_or_fuel_used.description: Cumulative computational units (WASM fuel or EVM gas) consumed during verified execution.

energy_kwh.description: Measured electrical energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (applicable to physical actuation).

cpu_seconds.description: Total compute execution time in seconds measured by runtime environment.

settlement_amount_credit_b.description: Exact volume of Credit B cleared from escrow in atomic units (1 Credit B = 10^18 atomic units).

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds recording the signature generation event.

nonce.description: Replay-prevention cryptographic nonce bound to the task escrow state.

beneficiary_ecdsa_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature (r, s, v) generated by the beneficiary over the canonical keccak256 digest of the receipt.
